title: VERY THIN AND FRAGILE
text: VERY THIN AND FRAGILE. I LIKE THE COLOR AND LOOK OF THIS ITEM, BUT WHEN I GOT IT OUT OF THE BOX, I WAS DISAPPOINTED TO FIND OUT THAT IT IS SO FRAGILE THAT IF I AM NOT CAREFUL, WHILE HANDLING IT, THE SO CALLED FABRIC IS EASY TO DAMAGE OR PUNCTURE. IT FEELS LIKE A STRAW MATERIAL SORT OF LIKE CEREAL, AND CRUMBLES EASILY JUST FROM TOUCHING IT WITH FINGERS TO MOVE THE PRODUCT. THE HINGES ARE ALSO PRETTY DELICATE, AND I AM CERTAIN IF THIS EVER SLIPS OR FALLS DOWN ON THE RUG FOR ANY REASON, (A LIGHT BREEZE COULD TOPPLE IT DOWN), IT WOULD EASILY BREAK APART.  I WOULD NOT PAY MORE THAN 14.99 FOR THIS TYPE OF ITEM AGAIN.  IT IS DEFINITELY NOT WORTH $49.00.  I EXPECTED WOULD AND SOME BASIC QUALITY FOR 49.00.  AS IT IS, I HAVE TO SECURE IT IN PLACE TO KEEP IT FROM FALLING OVER, AND IT WORKS OK FOR NOW. AS I SAID, IF YOU WANT ONE THAT MAY LAST AND NOT CRUMBLE APART IF YOU MOVE IT, BETTER FIND A HIGHER QUALITY ONE.  THIS WON'T LAST TOO LONG.
